title: 生涯スポーツ演習(救急法)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports(Fast Aid)

keywords: Lifelong sports 2.First aid 3.Cardiopulmonary resuscitation 4.Wounds and hemostasis 5.Bandage
educationalGoal: Through learning activities for First Aid, students will: 1.Understand the pleasure derived from sports. 2.Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle. 3.Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: This class aims to achieve the learning objectives through first aid:. 1. Daily life and first aid 2. Cardiopulmonary resuscitation,including the use of an automated external defibrillator(AED) 3. Wounds and hemostasis 4. Bandaginge 5. Fractures, dislocations, sprains 6. Response to sudden illness 7. Other ・Intensive lecture format (3 days) during summer holidays. Credits will not be recognized if there is even a one-time absence. ・Practical, loose, comfortable -clothes are required. Also, be sure to bring towels and drinking water. ・Always take care of your physical condition so that you can practice safely.
requiredKnowledge: An interest in accidents, injuries, illnesses, etc, in daily life.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express in sentences the importance of seeing (watching) and supporting sports.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for First Aid and use them in class activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2)Learn fundamental tennis skills and utilize them fully in class activities. (3)Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4)Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities. (5)Accurately express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activities.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2)Learn fundamental tennis skills and utilize them roughly in class activities. (3)Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4)Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in class activities. (5) Roughly express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.

lessons.content: ① Deepen understanding of how to proceed with this class. ② Daily life and first aid ・Understand accidents, injuries, illnesses, and first aid in everyday life.
lessons.assignments: Review: ・Confirm and fully understand the learning and behavioral goals. ・Carefully read and understand the handouts. ・Review and understand the lecture content.

lessons.content: ① Cardiopulmonary resuscitation ・Understand the importance of cardiopulmonary resuscitation. ・Understand when and where cardiopulmonary resuscitation is needed. ・Understand the contents of cardiopulmonary resuscitation. ② Check the current status of learning activities.
lessons.assignments: Preview and review: ・Understand the importance of cardiopulmonary resuscitation, and -its scope and content.

lessons.content: ① Learn how to secur the airway and administer artificial respiration and heart massage. ② Learn how to use an AED.
lessons.assignments: Review: ・Review and remember specific methods to secure the airway and administer artificial respiration and heart massage.

lessons.content: ① Wounds and hemostasis ・Understand the types and danger of different wounds. ・Understand and learn how to stop bleeding. ② Bandaging ・Learn how to use protective gauze, triangle bandages. ③ Check the current status of learning activities.
lessons.assignments: Review: ・Review and remember how to treat wounds and stop bleeding. ・Review and remember how to use triangle bandages.

lessons.content: Response to sudden illness ・Learn how to deal with sudden illnesses such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke, dyspnea, and convulsions.
lessons.assignments: Review: ・Understand how to deal with various symptoms and deepen understanding so that they can be appropriately treated.

lessons.content: ① Transport / rescue ・Understanding of transport methods and disaster knowledge. ・Practical test
lessons.operation: Conducted in the judo hall. Conduct a Practical test.
lessons.assignments: Homework: ・Write a report. Review: ・Prepare for the written test.

lessons.content: ① Summary of class content ② Written test ③ Questionnaire survey
lessons.operation: ・Conducted in the lecture hall. ・Summarize class content. ・Check attendance, assignments,-and grades.
lessons.assignments: Homework: ・Submit a portfolio report on life habits during the second semester.
